blocks.text: At least one copy of the Uniform Plumbing Code as adopted shall be on file with the City Clerk to be available for inspection by the public at all reasonable business hours. (Ord. 20257 § 5, 8-18-20.)

At least one copy of the Uniform Plumbing Code as adopted shall be on file with the City Clerk to be available for inspection by the public at all reasonable business hours. (Ord. 20257 § 5, 8-18-20.)
Cross References: City Clerk, TMC 2.20.010 .
title: Uniform Plumbing Code – Copies on file in Clerk’s office.
